name: Magneto

abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Arcangel, Nimrod ve Lady Deathstrike hariç metal şampiyon kullanma. Onu Özel 1'de tut ve enerji hasarlı şampiyonlar kullan.
signatureAbility:
Homo Superior
Magneto's mutation reaches Omega level, preventing him from losing more than [21,591.13 - 5,352.77] Health from any single damage source, excluding damage from a Special 3 Attack.
He also gains +[118.46 - 249.39] Critical Resistance and Block Penetration. Magnet: This attribute bonus is increased by +100%.
Heavy Attacks now deal a burst of [784.89 - 3,734.89] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Magnetism - Fighting #Metal Champions
content: #Metal opponents suffer an indefinite Magnetized Passive which is applied 1 second(s) after the start of the fight and does the following:
-70% Ability Accuracy & -105% Regeneration rate.
Magneto's abilities gain special Magnet bonuses.

abilitySections.title: Mutation - Always Active
content: Magneto's attacks deal Energy damage instead of Physical. Additionally, he gains +10% base Special Attack damage.
Incoming Bleed & Shock Debuffs suffer -90% Potency.
Magnet: +50% Perfect Block Chance.
Magnet: +[1,120.2] Attack rating.
Magnet: Attacks cannot be Auto-Blocked or Miss.

abilitySections.title: Magnet: Ignore Class Disadvantage
content: During fights where Magneto has a Class Disadvantage, he removes his Attack Penalty and his opponent loses their Attack Bonus.

abilitySections.title: Knock the Opponent Down
content: 100% chance to gain an indefinite Prowess Buff, which is removed after Magneto's next Special Attack and grants +20% Special Attack damage. Max Stacks: 5. Magnet: No Max Stack limit.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Magneto's force field grants him an Unstoppable Buff during the attack. If struck during a Heavy Attack, this effect goes on cooldown for 14 seconds. Magnet: Cooldown shortened by 10 seconds.
If held for 0.7 seconds, 100% chance per Prowess Buff to gain another Prowess Buff lasting 10 seconds and granting +5% Special Attack damage. Max Stacks: 30.

abilitySections.title: Magnet: Enhanced Bleed Debuffs
content: Personal Bleed Debuffs are upgraded into Shrapnel Bleeds which inflict [2,613.8] Physical damage when they end.
If the opponent is Immune to a Bleed Debuff, inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [562.5] for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [2,800.5] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.
If the opponent has an Armor Break Debuff, inflict an additional Bleed.
Magnet: Inflict an additional Bleed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [1,500] for 10 seconds. This Armor Break does not stack but is Re-applied each time Magneto gains a Prowess effect.
Magnet: This Debuff triggers when the Special Attack is launched.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the opponent is a #Hero Champion, 100% chance to gain a 30 second Fury Buff, granting +[2,800.5] Attack.
Magnet: 100% chance to gain a 30 second Fury Buff, granting +[2,800.5] Attack.
Each Prowess Buff on Magneto has a 70% chance to inflict 1 Bleed Debuff, causing [2,053.7] direct damage over 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Homo Superior
content: Magneto's mutation reaches Omega level, preventing him from losing more than [21,591.13 - 5,352.77] Health from any single damage source, excluding damage from a Special 3 Attack.
He also gains +[118.46 - 249.39] Critical Resistance and Block Penetration. Magnet: This attribute bonus is increased by +100%.
Heavy Attacks now deal a burst of [784.89 - 3,734.89] Energy Damage.
